user.title: Set up Occupancy Tracker
user.description: Occupancy Tracker reads your rooms, devices, and entities directly from Home Assistant — there's nothing to configure here yet. Select Submit to add it, then use Configure afterwards to draw your room topology and set egress points.

init.title: Zone presence settings
init.description: Optional: fuse companion-app/device-tracker zone presence with occupancy detection. Zone presence alone never changes a room's occupant count — it only corroborates confidence and can pre-arm automations ahead of confirmed arrival.

data.near_house_zones: Zones that count as "near the house" for pre-arming
